tasks.short: Direct tilling, planting, fertilizing, spraying and harvest.

steps.what: Set this week's field work and its order.
Publish that list to the crew.
Do the tilling, planting, spraying and harvesting listed.
Walk the work and note what slipped.
Change the list when the field requires it.

tasks.design: The manager still sets the week's field work on {OPS_SYSTEM}, from the annual plan, the weather and the crop stage. Publishing the list is a notice. The crew does the work. The manager walks it and changes the list in person. This is direction, not the safety check.
tasks.previous_blocker: The week's work was a conversation at the yard, and a rained-off job was easy to lose.
tasks.enabler_now: A list with block, job and day is a form the crew can open. The choice of what to do this week is not.
tasks.still_hard: Weather, a crop that is not ready, and a machine that is down still change the day.
tasks.human_edge: The manager knows which block cannot wait, and which job can slip a day.
tasks.altitude: The crew sees one list instead of a yard conversation. Setting the week, walking it and changing it stay with the manager.

reach.task: Do the listed job on that block

evidence.claim: A shared week list stops two people starting the same block. It does not decide the week.

assumptions: Workflow boundary: the farm manager directs. Workers do the field work. Safety adherence is a separate check against the rule, not this list.
Structured input: block id, job (till, plant, fertilize, spray, harvest), day, crew. Producer is the manager. A job with no block is not published.
Crew time stays on the crew. The manager's walk is not reduced to a tick.
unknowns: Does the crew already open a list, or only hear it?
Who may add a job mid-week?
research_questions: How often is the same block worked twice because the list was verbal?

already_counted.description: Setting the week is already the remaining time on that step.
The crew's field work is already remaining time on their step.

incremental.description: Close week lists that were superseded.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: If the crew will not open a list, publishing does nothing and the yard talk stays. Provisional.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Compare marketing and sales alternatives, and pick one.

steps.what: Pull margin and volume by sales channel.
Draft a comparison that uses only those figures.

loop.input: the channel table: volume, revenue, cost, margin
loop.output: a short comparison that quotes only those rows
loop.check: every number in the note must equal a table cell; else discard
loop.stop: one draft; a channel with no cost is marked unknown
loop.why_not_simpler: which channel to prefer is not a formula

steps.what: Pick the channel mix for the coming season.
Tell sales which mix was chosen.

tasks.design: Margin and volume by channel are a query on {ERP}, shown in {BI}. A comparison note is kept only when every figure equals that table. The manager picks the mix. Sales is told by {EMAIL}. Negotiating a single buyer is a different task.
tasks.previous_blocker: Channel comparisons were rebuilt in a private workbook before each season.
tasks.enabler_now: Volume, revenue and cost by channel are rows. A note can be checked against those rows.
tasks.still_hard: A buyer who might leave, and a channel the books have not priced, stay a judgement.
tasks.human_edge: The manager knows which channel still pays when the grade slips.

ambition.what: Compare channels each month, not only before the season.

tasks.altitude: Building the table takes less time. The pick stays. Sales hears the mix in the month it changes, not only at the season start.

reach.learn: Which channels are in, and which are out, this month

evidence.claim: A margin by channel is a query. Preferring a channel is not.

assumptions: Workflow boundary: the farm manager picks the mix. Sales staff sell it. A price negotiation with one buyer is out of this task.
Structured input: channel, period, volume, revenue, cost. Producer is the sales and cost ledger. A channel with no cost is shown as unknown, not estimated.
The comparison is a draft. The pick is the manager's remaining time.
unknowns: Are channel costs in the ledger, or only revenue?
Who else must agree a channel exit?
research_questions: How often is a channel kept for a reason the margin does not show?

already_counted.description: Picking the mix is already the remaining time on that step.

incremental.description: Map a new sales channel onto the ledger codes.

approvals.approved_version: mix the manager picked for that period

time_saved_range_pct.basis: If channel costs are not in the books, the note cannot be checked and the manager builds it by hand. The pick stays. Provisional.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Hire, supervise and train support workers without ranking them.

steps.what: Write what the vacancy must cover.
Interview the people who applied.
Choose one person, or choose none.
Send the offer from the signed template.
Supervise the work through the week.
Sign the induction items that were done.

tasks.design: The vacancy is a note the manager writes in {ATS}. Interviews and the choice stay in person. No score ranks applicants. The offer is the signed template, sent only after the choice note names one person. Supervision stays a walk. Induction items on {LMS} are signed by the manager, not ticked by a rule.
tasks.previous_blocker: Hiring was a pile of papers, and induction was whatever the manager remembered to say.
tasks.enabler_now: An offer template and a list of induction items are fixed text. Choosing a person is not.
tasks.still_hard: Who can do the work, and who will stay, comes from the interview.
tasks.human_edge: The manager hears what a person will not say on a form, and sees the work during the week.
tasks.altitude: The offer and the induction list are no longer retyped. Interviews, the choice and supervision stay. The manager does not gain a ranking.

reach.learn: Which items the manager has signed

evidence.claim: An offer can be filled from a template once a person is named. A score over applicants is a different system, and this design does not build one.

The source pack names a Dutch works-council rule for staff data, and the EU discussion treats ranking of people as a higher-risk use. Other countries differ. This design stores the application and does not rank.

assumptions: Workflow boundary: the farm manager defines the vacancy, interviews, chooses, supervises and signs induction. Payroll starts after the offer is accepted, outside this task.
Structured input: vacancy id, tasks the role covers, applicant id, choice (one person or none). Producer is the manager. An offer is refused when the choice note is empty.
No model reads applications. Interview time stays. Staff data needs a stated purpose and a retention date.
unknowns: Does a works council need to see the vacancy text?
research_questions: How many hires leave during induction?

already_counted.description: Interviewing is already the remaining time on that step.

incremental.description: Retire applications after the retention date.

approvals.approved_version: choice note naming one person and the vacancy

time_saved_range_pct.basis: If applications are paper, the offer template still needs the name typed once. Interviews are unchanged. Provisional.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Check irrigation, chemicals, harvest, milking, breeding and grading.

steps.what: Open the checklist the safety rule names.
Watch the irrigation, harvest, milking or grading.
Mark a pass, or name the exception.
File the chemical record from the signed protocol.
Stop the job when the exception is serious.

tasks.design: The checklist is the items the signed safety rule names, opened on {OPS_SYSTEM}. The manager still watches the work. A pass or an exception is their mark. A chemical record is filed only from the signed protocol, and only after that mark. Stopping a job stays in person. This is adherence, not the week's work list.
tasks.previous_blocker: Checks were a walk with no record, so a missed withdrawal or a bad grade was argued later.
tasks.enabler_now: The checklist items are the rule's own list. The chemical row is the protocol's product and rate.
tasks.still_hard: Whether an exception is serious enough to stop the job is still a judgement on the spot.
tasks.human_edge: The manager sees a milking or a spray that a tick-box would call finished.
tasks.altitude: The checklist and the chemical row are no longer rewritten. The watch and the stop stay. The manager does not gain a right to skip the watch.

reach.task: Stop when told, and record only the signed product

evidence.claim: A checklist copied from a signed rule is a query. Deciding an exception is not.
Chemical records are often a permit condition. The source pack does not name the farm statute, so the record stays tied to the signed protocol.

assumptions: Workflow boundary: the farm manager checks adherence. Directing the week's jobs is a different task. Workers do the work being watched.
Structured input: activity, block or animal group, rule id, result (pass or exception text). Producer is the manager on the watch. A chemical record is refused when the protocol has no row.
The watch is not replaced by the checklist.
unknowns: Is the safety rule a list of check items, or only prose?
Which activities happen on a given day?
research_questions: How often is a chemical use missing from the record?

already_counted.description: Watching the work is already the remaining time on that step.
Marking the exception is already remaining time.

incremental.description: Update the checklist when the safety rule version changes.

approvals.approved_version: pass or exception the manager marked for that activity

time_saved_range_pct.basis: If the safety rule is not a list, the checklist is typed once and the watch is unchanged. Provisional.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

role.altitude: The week list is published once. Hiring is interviews and a choice, never a ranking. Safety checks stay a watch, with the chemical record tied to a signed protocol.
reach: The crew sees one week list.
Sales hears the channel mix when it changes.
skills_to_grow: Change the week list in the field, not by letting the list run on.
Choose a person without a score.
role.ambitious_version: A channel mix can be compared each month, and an offer leaves only after a named choice.
